description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It defines multiple test methods to verify CRUD operations (getAll, getOne, create, update, delete) via API endpoints, utilizing test data providers, mocking, and fixture setup.

classes.name: MembershipAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to validate the MembershipAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system, covering getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete operations using data-driven tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test, truncating relevant tables and loading test data from YAML files.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all membership records via API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll API test, sourcing data from a YAML scenario file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single membership record via API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne API test, sourcing data from a YAML scenario file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new membership record through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create API operation.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing membership record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a membership record through the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the delete API operation.
